name: Spearmint
description: Mint is an energetic and cooling herb revered for its invigorating menthol aroma. It thrives easily in garden beds and containers, offering fresh leaves for summer drinks and savory dishes.
uses: Garnish for classic Mojitos, Juleps, and lemonade
Brewed into soothing digestive herbal teas
Key herb in Middle Eastern tabbouleh and tzatziki sauces
Aromatherapy for mental focus and cooling sensation

video.title: How to Grow Mint in Containers (And Get a Huge Harvest)

uses: Mint tea is a classic remedy for indigestion, gas and queasiness
Inhaled steam or aroma traditionally used to ease a stuffy nose
Chewed leaves freshen breath and soothe the mouth
benefits: Menthol gives a cooling, calming effect on the stomach and throat
May help relax digestive muscles and ease discomfort after meals
medicinal.caution: Mint can worsen acid reflux in some people. Concentrated mint oils should not be used on or near the face of babies and young children.
